title: saturating-nuclear-dyad-category
description: The codomain generated by saturating: the category whose objects are Heyting algebras carrying a single saturation nucleus and whose morphisms are the nucleus-preserving Heyting homomorphisms. Each object is a nuclear dyad joining the free carrier to its fixed-point layer by the reflection sigma dashv iota.

carrier.description: the free pole A: a Heyting algebra

nucleus.description: a single saturation nucleus sigma on A (inflationary, idempotent, meet-preserving closure)

fixedPoints.description: the sub-pole Fix(sigma): the history-determined layer of sigma-fixed elements

reflection.description: the dyad A <-> Fix(sigma) is an adjunction sigma dashv iota, the closure sigma left adjoint to the inclusion iota

morphisms.description: arrows are Heyting-algebra homomorphisms that commute with sigma
